verdict.rationale: Vercel's own GitHub repo vercel/vercel, which holds the Vercel CLI and framework builders, is published under Apache 2.0. That is a genuine open license on part of the product's own source. However, the evidence covers only the client-side tooling, not the hosted platform that makes up most of the product. Missing for 10: evidence that the core platform/runtime source is available under an open license, and a broader inventory of which Vercel components are open-source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
